title: CHANGE MY HEART O LORD

lines.text: You are the potter, I am the clay,

chords:
[Chorus]
[D][Em]Change my [F#m][A]heart, O [Em][D]Lord,[A][Bm]
Make it ever [D]new,[Bm]
Change my heart, O Lord,
May [Em]I be [A]like [D]You.

[Verse 1]
[F#7]You are the [Bm]potter, [Em]I am the [A]clay,
[F#7]Mould me and [Bm]make me,
[E7]This is what I [A]pray.[A7]
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Change my heart, O Lord,
Make it ever new,
Change my heart, O Lord,
May I be like You.

[Verse 1]
You are the potter, I am the clay,
Mould me and make me,
This is what I pray.
